explanation: Horizontal displacement x = \u03c0R = \u03c0(1) = \u03c0 m.\nVertical displacement y = 2R = 2(1) = 2 m.\nNet displacement = \u221a(x\u00b2 + y\u00b2) = \u221a(\u03c0\u00b2 + 2\u00b2) = \u221a(\u03c0\u00b2 + 4) m.

explanation: When time intervals are equal (t\u2081 = t\u2082 = t):\nv_avg = (v\u2081 + v\u2082) / 2 = (80 + 40) / 2 = 60 km/h.

explanation: Total distance D = L_train + L_bridge = 150 + 850 = 1000 m.\nSpeed v = 45 \u00d7 (5/18) = 12.5 m/s.\nTime t = D / v = 1000 / 12.5 = 80 seconds.

questionText: A man walks on a straight road from home to market 2.5 km away at 5 km/h. Finding the market closed, he instantly walks back at 7.5 km/h. His average speed over the time interval 0 to 40 min is [AMU (Med.) 2002]
explanation:
Time to reach market t₁ = 2.5 / 5 = 0.5 h = 30 min.
Remaining time = 10 min = 1/6 h.
Distance in return journey = 7.5 × (1/6) = 1.25 km.
Total distance = 2.5 + 1.25 = 3.75 km = 15/4 km.
Total time = 40/60 h = 2/3 h.
Average speed = (15/4) / (2/3) = 45/8 km/h = 5.625 km/h.
